test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for equal opportunity for all citizens in the matter of employment under the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 16**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 16 of the Constitution of India **safeguards **equality of opportunity in public employment**.
 
• It prohibits discrimination against citizens based on various factors including **religion, race, caste, sex, descent, place of birth, and residence**.
 
• Article 16 permits the state to implement reservations in public employment for citizens belonging to **backward classes**.
 
• Moreover, the government has the authority to enact reservation policies for any community if they are not adequately represented in service or posts under the State.
 
• This provision aims to address historical injustices and promote inclusivity in public employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 17 **of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and prohibits its practice in any form.
 
• **Article 18 **of the Constitution of India abolishes the conferring and recognition of titles.
 
• **Article 15** of the Indian Constitution prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
